units.source_text: 夕雾遣使送信与落叶公主，但公主不肯拆阅。

en.t: Yugiri sent a messenger with a letter to Princess Ochiba, but the princess refused to open and read it.

units.source_text: 她昨夜突然遭此困窘，惊魂未定，又觉可耻，心中不胜懊恼。

en.t: After being suddenly placed in such a painful predicament the night before, she was still shaken, felt ashamed, and was overwhelmed with distress.

units.source_text: 她想：“母亲倘知道了，教我何以为颜？

en.t: She thought, If my mother finds out, how could I possibly face her?

units.source_text: 她做梦也不曾想到此种事情，一旦看出我神情异常，或者由于世人不肯隐恶，消息传入她的耳中，那时她将怪我欺瞒，教我何等痛苦！

en.t: She would never have dreamed of such a thing, and if she notices my strange manner, or if people refuse to hide the scandal and the news reaches her ears, she will blame me for deceiving her, and how painful that will be for me.

units.source_text: 倒不如叫侍女们向她如实报告。

en.t: It would be better to have the ladies in waiting tell her the truth exactly as it is.

units.source_text: 她听了心中悲伤，也无可如何了。”

en.t: She will be saddened when she hears it, but there is nothing more to be done.

units.source_text: 母女二人一向十分亲睦，毫无半点隔阂。

en.t: Mother and daughter had always been very close, without the slightest distance between them.

units.source_text: 从前的小说中往往有告诉外人而欺瞒父母的事例，但落叶公主不想如此。

en.t: In old tales there were often cases of confiding in outsiders while deceiving one's parents, but Princess Ochiba did not wish to do that.

units.source_text: 众侍女相与议论：“即使老夫人略有所闻，公主也何必真有其事似的愁这般、愁那般呢？

en.t: The ladies in waiting discussed it among themselves, saying, Even if the old lady hears a little of it, why should the princess worry about this and that as if something truly happened?

units.source_text: 提前担心，也太痛苦了。”

en.t: To suffer by worrying in advance is far too painful.

units.source_text: 她们不知实情究竟如何，想看看这封来信。

en.t: Not knowing what the truth really was, they wanted to see the letter that had arrived.

units.source_text: 但公主拆都不肯拆开。

en.t: But the princess would not even agree to open it.

units.source_text: 她们着急了，对公主说：“置之不答，毕竟是不成样的，像无知小儿一般了。”

en.t: They grew anxious and said to the princess, Leaving it unanswered is improper after all, and makes you seem like an ignorant child.

units.source_text: 便把来信拆开呈上。

en.t: Then they opened the letter and presented it to her.

units.source_text: 公主说道：“我气得发昏了！

en.t: The princess said, I am so angry I feel faint.

units.source_text: 虽然只和那人见面一次，终是我自己轻率之罪过。

en.t: Although I met that man only once, in the end it was still the fault of my own carelessness.

units.source_text: 但想起了他那不顾别人、胡行妄为的行径，实在难于容忍。

en.t: But when I think of the way he acted recklessly and without regard for others, it is truly hard to endure.

units.source_text: 你们回复他，说我不要看信就是了。”

en.t: You may reply to him and simply say that I do not want to read his letter.

units.source_text: 便异常苦闷地躺下。

en.t: Then she lay down in extreme anguish.

units.source_text: 夕雾的信并不十分可憎，只是一往情深地写着：

en.t: Yugiri's letter was not especially hateful; it was simply written with deep and single minded feeling:
